An open circular arrow is accompanied by two detached circles and a triangle at lower left. The disconnected shapes do not form a clearly recognizable reproductive scene or an established main-subject-plus-modifier arrangement.

## Visual draft

An open circular form ends in an arrow pointing upper right. Two detached circles and a triangle cluster near its lower left opening, with no clear connection between them.

## Open question

What do the two circles and triangle represent, and should the open circular arrow remain open? Confirm the intended gender or reproduction symbol before generation.

## 1. Open circular arrow (sub)

An incomplete circular outline has a diagonal arrow extending from its upper right side. Exclude the two detached circles and triangle; preserve the lower-left opening pending confirmation.

## 2. Unequal circle pair (sub)

Two separate plain circles sit diagonally beside each other, the right circle slightly higher and larger. Exclude the circular arrow and triangle.

## 3. Upright outline triangle (sub)

An upright triangle has two equal sloping sides and a horizontal base. Exclude the circular arrow and detached circle pair.
